information.description:
A mix of smalltime veterans and self-proven recruits, Barghest’s mid-tier leaders often lead smaller squads all around Dogtown. They keep their mini-pack on a leash as they do Hansen’s dirty work, but aren’t total warhounds. Not yet, anyway.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Once upon a time, in the second half of the 20th century, the world's most popular assault rifle was the AK-47 – also commonly known as the Kalashnikov, in honor of its inventor. Today, these rifles can only be found in museums as their market niche was replaced by the Nokota Copperhead. This mass-produced assault rifle sticks to the basics of functionality and reliability. There's no finesse or ingenuity to fall in love with, but many people find its dependable stopping power endearing.

Cost: 350eb (Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 3 • Attachments: Carbine Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

The Omaha looks like your classic lead-spitter, but don't let appearances fool you. This gem from Militech conceals its powerful electromag rail system which launches solid-metal projectiles instead of firing ordinary pistol rounds. With each pull of the trigger, the Omaha quietly slings out three projectiles with tremendous force behind them. It's no wonder it’s commonly found in the holsters of corpos at the high end of the food chain.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 9 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: After being charged, this weapon’s Tech Rebuild remains so until the end of a Turn in which it was fired. While charged, this weapon remains ROF 2, expends 3 rounds in a burst with every Attack, and whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP. Incompatible with Pistol Auto Sear.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.
Medium version of an Armorjack. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Internal Body Cyberware.

Use an Action to load one dose of Street Drug into a subdermal storage pod. Optionally, one can configure a Biomonitor to automatically dose the user upon entering combat, suffering a critical injury, or reaching a predetermined Wound State threshold.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
